_README.purpose: Set custom eBay search terms for cards that don't pull prices correctly.
how_to_use: 1. Add an entry below using the card NUMBER as the key.
2. Set the value to the exact search phrase you'd type into eBay.
3. Save this file and re-run:  node scrape-prices.js
4. To test a single card:      node scrape-prices.js --card=001
_README.default_behavior: If a card has NO entry here, it searches:  '<defaultPrefix> <Card Name>'
_README.tip: Copy the eBay search that gives you the best sold results, then paste it here.
